title: A hook that fires once per session, in the real plugin tree
pattern: reinvented helper in a large tree
expectation: Chosen because hooks/lib/markers.mjs (sessionMarkerPath, createMarkerOnce, readMarker, writeMarker) is used by about ten hooks (seat-skill-hint.mjs, phase-guard.mjs, session-start.mjs, skill-enforcement.mjs and others), hooks/lib/stdin.mjs (readHookInput) by every hook, and hooks/lib/emit.mjs by the same set, yet the prompt names none of them. A once-per-session reminder is exactly their job. Without guidance the agent, having read a hook or two, writes its own temp file with node:fs, reads stdin by hand or prints JSON itself, or adds a parallel helper under hooks/lib.
prompt: Add a new hook script claude-plugins/task-orchestrator/hooks/plan-reminder.mjs. It runs on UserPromptSubmit and reads the hook's JSON input from stdin. The first time it runs in a given session it adds the one-line reminder "Check items_read next before you plan." to the model's context; every later invocation in the same session must stay silent (each invocation is a new process). Do not register it in hooks-config.json. Add a test next to the other hook tests.

checks.pattern: does not reuse the marker helpers
scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
